Rocktail For Three
By: Karina
Published: Sunday, May 15, 2011 - 8:24pm

Ingredients




ROCK YOU
1 ounce Effen Vodka
1 1/2 teaspoons orange juice
1 1/2 teaspoons grenadine
1 1/2 teaspoons 7- up
ROCK ME
1 ounce Effen Vodka
1 ounce Melon liqueur
1 1/2 teaspoons pineapple schnapps
1/2 teaspoon sour mix
ROCK ON
1 ounce Effen Vodka
1/2 ounce Peach schnapps,
1 1/2 teaspoons grenadine
1 1/2 teaspoons champagne

Preparation

1 Rub the rims of three shot glasses with lemon juice. Dip one glass in red sugar, one in green sugar and one in pick. 2 For Rock You: In shaker combine vodka, orange juice and grenadine with ice. Shake; strain into read-rimmed glass, top with 7-Up. 3 For Rock Me: In shaker combine ingredients with ice. Shake: strain into green-rimmed glass. 4 For Rock On:  In shaker combine vodka, schnapps, grenadine and ice. Shake; strain into pink-rimmed glass. Top with champagne.
